$comment: Taking the secret out of a line before anything else sees it, read by tests/shared/redact.test.ts and the Android SharedCorpusTest. $cases: `line` is what is about to go on the wire; `redacted` is what anything watching should see. A line with no secret in it comes back unchanged.
